chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, via his chain, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When one of you finishes his ablution, let him take a handful of water and wipe his neck with it; that will be the freedom of his neck from the Fire.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice after completing wudu to seek freedom from the Fire?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), establishing the wiping of the nape of the neck with leftover wudu water as a recommended act (mustahabb) that serves as a 'ransom' (fakaak) from the Hellfire. This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on transforming mundane acts of purification into spiritual safeguards, linking physical cleanliness with eschatological deliverance.
